title: The reducer change of BG-hfakjbdf moves the doc hash of every github.com page row once, and web-sources.md says nothing of the one false change
goal: kb/_self/web-sources.md names, in the paragraph that describes the reducer's skip of role=tooltip and visually hidden elements, that the skip (and its end at an omitted end tag) changes the stored doc_sha256 of a github.com page row once without the page changing, so the first detect after the change is not read as a source change and the github.com rows of the fetch state stay as they are. Found by the SP-c6tr77jl review (S3, 110 github.com rows hold a doc_sha256).

run: import sys;L=[l.lower() for l in open('kb/_self/web-sources.md',encoding='utf-8') if 'role=tooltip' in l];print(len(L));sys.exit(0 if any('doc_sha256' in l and 'once' in l and 'github.com' in l for l in L) else 1)

repro_reason: the false change shows only on a live detect of a github.com page, which needs the network; the repro reads that web-sources.md names the one-time change on the line that describes the tooltip skip
notes: Planner settled the draft's open choice: document the one-time change, no re-baseline of _fetch_state.csv (a shared content file other sessions plan).
